name: jsone-website
description: JSOne corporate website - Astro + Sanity + Node API monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run check -w web && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w studio
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:lighthouse
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start
